key_insight: In STEMI patients, primary ventricular tachyarrhythmias were associated with a distinct gut microbiome signature that could help stratify risk using machine learning.
clinical_relevance: If validated, these stool-based microbial markers could support earlier identification of STEMI patients at higher risk for VT/VF.
method: 33 STEMI patients sampled in the acute and recovery phases
Full-length 16S rRNA sequencing with machine learning feature selection
evidence_signal: A reduced-feature support vector machine using acute-phase taxa achieved AUC 0.846 with 85.7% sensitivity and 76.9% specificity.
watch_item: This was a small exploratory cohort, so the biomarker signature needs independent validation before any clinical use.
paper_title: Machine Learning Approach to Identify Gut Microbiota Biomarkers in Patients with ST-Elevation Myocardial Infarction Presenting Primary Ventricular Tachyarrhythmias
